extracted.name: Chinese Chicken Salad
extracted.description: Recipe video above. This one is all about the fabulous Asian Dressing and the slaw-type shape of the ingredients. Don't skip the crunchy noodles, they totally make this! Alternative Dressing: standby Asian Sesame Dressing (keeps for weeks).
ingredient_lines: 3 tbsp rice vinegar ((aka rice wine vinegar, or use cider vinegar))
2 tbsp grapeseed oil ((or canola or any other neutral flavored oil))
1 1/2 tsp fresh ginger (, grated or very finely chopped)
4 cups Chinese cabbage ((Nappa Cabbage), finely shredded (Note 2))
1/2 cup shallots / scallions (, finely sliced on the diagonal)
1/2 to 1 cup crunchy noodles ((I use Chang's) (Note 3))
instruction_lines: Combine the Dressing ingredients in a jar and shake. Set aside for 10 minutes or so for the flavours to meld.
Place the Salad ingredients together in a large bowl along with half the crunchy noodles. Drizzle over dressing then toss. (Note 4)
Divide between serving bowls. Top with more crunchy noodles and a good sprinkle of sesame seeds. Serve immediately!
